input_boundary: Extracted atomic facts and oracle candidate memories are supplied directly. Extraction and retrieval are not evaluated here.
description: Untouched batched reconciliation holdout for the frozen hosted memory configuration. Run once and never tune against these cases.

notes: This holdout must not influence prompts or implementation before its single run.
Targets are scored by stable candidate ID and UPDATE wording by deterministic content assertions.

cases.description: Three unrelated facts remain independent creations.

fact.content: The user wants to learn pottery.
fact.evidence: I want to learn pottery

fact.content: The user prefers meetings with a written agenda.
fact.evidence: I prefer meetings with a written agenda

fact.content: The user values fairness.
fact.evidence: Fairness matters deeply to me

cases.description: An exact goal invalidation must not suppress an unrelated preference creation.

fact.content: The user no longer wants to volunteer at the animal shelter.
fact.evidence: I no longer plan to volunteer at the animal shelter

candidate_memories.content: The user wants to volunteer at an animal shelter.
The user wants to organize a charity fundraiser.

fact.content: The user prefers a savory breakfast.
fact.evidence: I prefer a savory breakfast

cases.description: Two replacements resolve against different local candidate lists.

fact.content: The user now lives in Lisbon.
fact.evidence: I moved from Porto to Lisbon

candidate_memories.content: The user works for Cedar Systems.
The user lives in Porto.

fact.content: The user now prefers afternoon meetings.
fact.evidence: I now prefer afternoon meetings instead of morning ones

candidate_memories.content: The user prefers morning meetings.
The user prefers meetings with an agenda.

cases.description: Overlapping goal refinements may mutate a shared snapshot target only once.

fact.content: The user wants to complete a cycling tour in September.
fact.evidence: I want to complete the cycling tour in September

candidate_memories.content: The user wants to complete a cycling tour.

fact.content: September is the user's target month for the cycling tour.
fact.evidence: September is my target month for it

candidate_memories.content: The user wants to complete a cycling tour.

cases.description: Two renderings of the same new preference create one memory only.

fact.content: The user prefers reading before bed.
fact.evidence: I prefer reading before bed

fact.content: Reading at bedtime is the user's preference.
fact.evidence: reading at bedtime is what I like

cases.description: Topically similar but distinct facts are new creations, not updates.

fact.content: The user wants to learn Italian.
fact.evidence: I want to learn Italian

candidate_memories.content: The user wants to improve their French.

fact.content: The user values financial independence.
fact.evidence: Financial independence matters to me

candidate_memories.content: The user prefers using a monthly budget.

cases.description: An invalidation with no matching candidate is a NOOP.

fact.content: The user no longer wants to learn the violin.
fact.evidence: I gave up learning violin

candidate_memories.content: The user wants to learn guitar.
The user enjoys classical music.

cases.description: Already represented paraphrases produce only NOOP decisions.

fact.content: The user values dependable friendships.
fact.evidence: Dependability in friendship matters to me

candidate_memories.content: The user values reliability in close friendships.

fact.content: The user prefers walking meetings.
fact.evidence: Walking meetings are my preference

candidate_memories.content: The user likes to hold meetings while walking.

cases.description: One batch exercises create, update, invalidate, and noop without interference.

fact.content: The user wants to study astronomy.
fact.evidence: I want to study astronomy

fact.content: The user now works at Northwind Health.
fact.evidence: I now work at Northwind Health instead of Harbor Tech

candidate_memories.content: The user works at Harbor Tech.

fact.content: The user no longer plans to write a cookbook.
fact.evidence: I abandoned the cookbook plan

candidate_memories.content: The user wants to write a cookbook.

fact.content: The user values curiosity.
fact.evidence: Curiosity is still one of my core values

candidate_memories.content: The user values curiosity and lifelong discovery.

cases.description: An explicit guitar-goal invalidation must not target another hobby goal.

fact.content: The user no longer wants to learn guitar.
fact.evidence: Learning guitar is no longer my goal

candidate_memories.content: The user wants to start a vegetable garden.
The user wants to learn guitar.

cases.description: A narrowed goal updates the same underlying goal and preserves its scope.

fact.content: The user wants to network specifically at renewable-energy conferences.
fact.evidence: I want to focus my networking on renewable-energy conferences

candidate_memories.content: The user wants to expand their professional network.
The user follows renewable-energy news.

cases.description: The same proposition under an adjacent taxonomy is already represented.

fact.content: The user has decided to save for a home deposit.
fact.evidence: I decided to start saving for a home deposit

candidate_memories.content: The user wants to save money for a home deposit.
